statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93247
The denial reason code was CO-197
The clinical indication note documents persistent palpitations and episodes of dizziness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias contributing to these symptoms
CPT 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
